newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Camdessus says agrees with Greenspan on stocks.
newsitem.headline: Camdessus says agrees with Greenspan on stocks.

text.p: International Monetary Fund (IMF) managing director Michel Camdessus said on Monday he agreed with U.S. Federal Reserve Board chairman Alan Greenspan's warning that stock markets could be rising too quickly.

"In general I agree very much with Alan Greenspan, particularly when he warned about overshooting in whatever direction," Camdessus told reporters on the fringes of the World Trade Organisation ministerial meeting when asked about Greenspan's comments.
"I welcome the statement he made," Camdessus said.

Greenspan sent world financial markets tumbling late last week when he said the central bank needed to be wary when "irrational exuberance" infects stock and other asset markets because that could do damage to the economy.
